svg.text: User sends an HTTP (port 80) request over the Internet.
Traffic enters the VPC through the Internet Gateway (IGW).
ALB (myalb1) listener on port 80 forwards to target group (myalbtgname).
ALB forwards to healthy EC2 instances (Ec21 or Ec22) on port 80.
EC2 instances read S3 using the IAM role, via the IGW (no VPC endpoint).
• ALB is deployed in both subnets (one node per AZ).
• EC2 instances have public IPs and can be reached
directly (bypassing the ALB) on ports 22 and 80.
• S3 access uses the IAM role (read-only: ListBucket,
GetObject) via the IGW; there is no VPC endpoint.
• One security group is used for the ALB and both EC2s.
